title: Reorganize String (No Adjacent Equal)

monster.name: Alternating Drake
monster.title: Enforcer of Non-Repeating Breaths
monster.defeatQuote: Your max-heap interleaved my characters without repetition!

description: Given a string `s`, rearrange the characters of `s` so that any two adjacent characters are not the same. Return any possible rearrangement of `s` or return `""` if not possible.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters
solutionCode:
def reorganizeString(s: str) -> str:
    import heapq
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(s)
    max_freq = max(counts.values())
    if max_freq > (len(s) + 1) // 2:
        return ""
    heap = [(-count, ch) for ch, count in counts.items()]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    res = []
    prev_cnt, prev_ch = 0, ''
    while heap:
        cnt, ch = heapq.heappop(heap)
        res.append(ch)
        if prev_cnt < 0:
            heapq.heappush(heap, (prev_cnt, prev_ch))
        prev_cnt = cnt + 1
        prev_ch = ch
    return ''.join(res)

python.solutionCode:
def reorganizeString(s: str) -> str:
    import heapq
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(s)
    max_freq = max(counts.values())
    if max_freq > (len(s) + 1) // 2:
        return ""
    heap = [(-count, ch) for ch, count in counts.items()]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    res = []
    prev_cnt, prev_ch = 0, ''
    while heap:
        cnt, ch = heapq.heappop(heap)
        res.append(ch)
        if prev_cnt < 0:
            heapq.heappush(heap, (prev_cnt, prev_ch))
        prev_cnt = cnt + 1
        prev_ch = ch
    return ''.join(res)
